question_en: Return the specs modified by CRs that resolutions approved (decision-to-spec impact).
query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT sp.specNumber, count(r) AS resolutions ORDER BY resolutions DESC LIMIT 10
